name: BMP-3

cost.display: Legacy/continuing production, 2,000+ built - no clean current unit price

key_facts.label: Main armament
key_facts.value: 100mm 2A70 gun + 30mm 2A72 autocannon + AGS-30 grenade launcher (Bakhcha-U/Berezhok turret)

characteristics: 100mm 2A70 gun + 30mm 2A72 autocannon + AGS-30 grenade launcher (Bakhcha-U/Berezhok turret)
Strength: Unusual dual-gun armament (100mm + 30mm) gives both anti-armor and anti-personnel capability from one turret
Limitation: Aluminium-alloy armor is lighter than steel but still thin relative to drone/ATGM threats now common
Estimated quantity available: Continuing limited production; current fielded total not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Represents Russia's most modern mass-fielded IFV design, but like the BMP-2 has proven highly vulnerable to top-attack drone strikes that its era of design never anticipated
contrast_vs_traditional: The BMP-3's larger 100mm gun and improved protection over the BMP-2 were built to win the vehicle-vs-vehicle fight that dominated Soviet mechanized doctrine. Neither addresses the threat actually killing IFVs now — a top-attack drone strike doesn't care about turret armament — which is the same gap the doctrine.md figure on drone-attributed losses points at across every armored category.

sources.label: Army Recognition — Russia increases BMP-3 production for the Ukraine war
